skill.name: amazon-asin-lookup-api-skill
skill.description: Extract Amazon product metadata from an ASIN through BrowserAct's workflow API, including title, price, ratings, brand, URL, description, and selected specifications.
skill.summary: Look up Amazon product data from an ASIN through BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs intentional outbound requests to BrowserAct's workflow API and uses a BrowserAct API key. Most command and reconnaissance matches are Markdown formatting or normal error handling. The confirmed concern is guidance that may expose API keys in chat.

remediation.issue: API key may be requested through chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide the key in conversation. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or a secrets manager.

remediation.issue: External BrowserAct API calls are required.
remediation.suggestion: Document that ASIN values, task ids, and authorization headers are sent to BrowserAct, and require user consent before running the workflow.

remediation.issue: ASIN input is not validated before use.
remediation.suggestion: Validate ASIN format before starting the workflow and reject unexpected characters or empty values.

content.value_statement: Amazon product pages are difficult to convert into reliable structured data. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns product metadata for a supplied ASIN.
actual_capabilities: Runs a bundled Python script for one Amazon ASIN at a time.
Starts a BrowserAct workflow template for Amazon ASIN lookup.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion or timeout.
Returns product title, URL, brand, price, rating, description, and selected attributes when available.
Reports missing or invalid BrowserAct API key errors.
Guides a single retry for non-authorization failures.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key before use.
Sends the ASIN and workflow request to BrowserAct's external API.
Results depend on Amazon page availability and BrowserAct service behavior.
It does not search Amazon by keyword or discover ASINs automatically.

use_cases.title: Enrich Catalog Records
use_cases.description: Add Amazon title, brand, price, description, and attribute data to product records from known ASINs.

use_cases.title: Check Competitive Pricing
use_cases.description: Retrieve current Amazon price and rating data for products that need periodic market comparison.

use_cases.title: Validate Product Metadata
use_cases.description: Confirm product URLs, ratings, badges, and key specifications before importing marketplace data.

prompt_templates.title: Lookup One Product
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single known ASIN.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up ASIN B07TS6R1SF and summarize the product title, brand, price, rating, and availability fields.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Product Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this ASIN to create a concise catalog summary with price, product URL, description, and special features.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several ASINs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that repeats the workflow for several products.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the lookup for these ASINs one by one, then compare price, rating count, brand, and key features in a table.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Marketplace Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operational workflow for import checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: For each ASIN in my import list, retrieve Amazon metadata, flag missing fields, and note any products with unusual price or rating changes.

output: Product title and brand returned from the BrowserAct workflow.
Current price, original price, rating average, and rating count when available.
Amazon product URL and selected feature fields for review.

output_examples.input: Check this ASIN before adding it to our catalog.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes the Amazon listing, highlights available attributes, and notes missing fields that need manual review.

output_examples.input: Compare these known ASINs for a pricing review.
output_examples.output: The result lists each product with its current price, rating count, brand, and notable differences across the requested ASINs.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment variable or secret, not in chat.
Validate ASIN values before running the workflow.
Record lookup time because prices and ratings can change.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into conversation messages.
Do not use the skill for unauthorized bulk collection or policy-violating scraping.
Do not assume price, availability, or rating data remains current after retrieval.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs one Amazon ASIN and a configured BrowserAct API key.

faq.question: Does it require an Amazon account?
faq.answer: No Amazon account is configured in the skill. It uses BrowserAct's workflow API.

faq.question: Where should I store the API key?
faq.answer: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment or a secrets manager. Do not paste it into chat.

faq.question: Can it process many ASINs?
faq.answer: The script accepts one ASIN per run. An agent can run it repeatedly for a small list.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return title, URL, brand, price, ratings, description, badges, and selected product attributes.

faq.question: Why can results vary?
faq.answer: Amazon listings, regional availability, and BrowserAct workflow output can change over time.
